newsitem.title: UK: NatWest hires European equity markets head.
newsitem.headline: NatWest hires European equity markets head.

text.p: NatWest Markets, the investment banking arm of Britain's National Westminster Bank Plc, said on Friday it had hired Alex Graham as head of global syndication and European equity capital markets.
NatWest said in a statement that Graham, 33, had been co-head of equity capital markets and syndicate in Europe for Salomon Brothers. He had been at Salomon since 1986.
